title: Totalization of a single nonnegative row
statement: Let C be an abelian category admitting diagonal totals of every nonnegative double complex. For every nonnegative cochain complex L and q≥0, the total complex obtained by placing L in vertical degree q is isomorphic to L extended by zero along i↦i+q.

source.place: Proof steps 1 and 2, first sequence; spectral-object reformulation

proof.text: For L placed in vertical degree q, include L.X i into the total diagonal in degree i+q using the inverse single-term component isomorphism and the coproduct injection. Construct its inverse by totalDesc: the (a,b) component is zero for b≠q and is the single-term component isomorphism followed by the equality a=i otherwise. The coproduct universal property proves both composites are identities. Diagonals not in the image of i↦i+q are zero, since every summand is zero.

Identify the degree-n term of the extension by zero with this diagonal, using i=n-q when n is in the translation image and the canonical isomorphism of zero objects otherwise. The total differential applied to the surviving injection has zero vertical part and horizontal part L.d i j with sign +1. The extend_d_eq formula identifies the extension differential with this horizontal map. When either degree is outside the image, the corresponding source or target is zero. Assemble the resulting component isomorphisms with HomologicalComplex.Hom.isoOfComponents and take its inverse.
